entries.note: Closed list of 11 congregations, 3 tribunals, 5 offices from 3 Nov 1908. Rename Inquisition -> Holy Office; Bishops-and-Regulars dissolved (diocesan matters to Consistorial, religious to new Congregation of Religious); Sacraments created; Lauretana united to Council; Visitation and Revision of Councils suppressed; Rota revived; Signatura refounded; Secretariat of Briefs becomes 3rd part of the Secretariat of State. Sapienti consilio creates the Congregation for the Discipline of the Sacraments (3rd congregation, 'new'); it takes sacramental/matrimonial matters from Council, Rites, Datary and Penitentiary (research erected.note). Other effects of the act have their own research events and are not repeated here: Inquisition renamed (ev021), Bishops-and-Regulars dissolved (ev024), Religious created (ev024), Lauretana united to Council (ev018), Revision of Councils ended (ev019), Visitation suppressed (ev025), Rota revived (ev023), Signatura re-founded (ev020). The Secretariat of Briefs becoming the 3rd part of the Secretariat of State is a placement between two held-out bodies and is omitted.
